sections.title: Formal openings
phrases: I am writing to request / enquire about / complain about …
I am writing in response to your letter of 13 January.
With reference to your advertisement in …, I would like to …

sections.title: Formal closings
phrases: I look forward to hearing from you.
If you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Once again, I apologise for any inconvenience.

sections.title: Informal openings and closings
phrases: Hi there, I hope you're doing well. It's been ages since we last met!
Thanks so much for your letter.
Anyway, I'd better go now. Call me if you need anything.
Can't wait to hear from you!
